doc_name: List of members of the tenth Parliament of Uganda
text: This list details the members elected to the tenth Parliament of Uganda, which served from 2016 to 2021, following the ninth Parliament (2011 to 2016) and preceding the eleventh Parliament, which began in 2021. The acting Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Uganda, Steven Kavuma, presided over the election of the Speaker of the tenth Parliament, which was won by Rebecca Alitwala Kadaga, making her the tenth Speaker of that Parliament. Kadaga then oversaw the election of the Deputy Speaker, with Muhammad Nsereko and Jacob Oulanya both running; Oulanya received 300 votes compared to Nsereko’s 115 votes, and President Yoweri Museveni was present during the vote.
